E0952

Compile-time step limit reached

What

Compile-time step limit reached

Why

Compile-time code runs under a step limit, 10000000 steps unless its binding sets another, so a runaway loop can't stall the build

Fix

Split the work so it fits; a binding computed while building raises its own limit with `#StepLimit(n)`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0952: Tests/UI/comptime_fuel.stderr.

Error [jet.ComptimeFuelExhausted]: Compile-time code ran past its step limit of 10000000 steps
  --> Tests/UI/comptime_fuel.jet:7:9
    |
  7 | X: #run spin()
    |         ^^^^
 Why: Compile-time code runs under a step limit, 10000000 steps unless its binding sets another, so a runaway loop can't stall the build
 Fix: Split the work so it fits; a binding computed while building raises its own limit above 10000000 with `#StepLimit(n)`
